chunks: The day He will gather you together on the Day of Gathering, will be the day of Judgement. He who believed and did the right, will have his evil deeds expunged by God and admitted to gardens with rivers flowing by, and abide there perpetually. This will be the great achievement of success.

key_terms.يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ: He will expunge his evil deeds

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for believers who perform righteous deeds on the Day of Judgement?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'Yawm al-Taghabun' (Day of Mutual Disillusion) highlights the contrast between the believers' ultimate success and the disbelievers' regret, emphasizing that divine forgiveness for sins is contingent upon both sincere faith (Iman) and practical righteousness (Amal al-Salih). This verse underscores the Shia principle of the inseparability of belief and action, promising eternal residence in Paradise as the 'greatest victory' (al-fawz al-'azim) for those who align their deeds with divine will.
